{{Quote| While it's true damotite's a better product, trenomite's much easier to get hold of, which makes it cheaper. And it's more stable to work with.|[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], about trenomite|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>}}
'''Trenomite''' was a [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. It was easier to find, cheaper to buy, and more stable to work with, so it took the spotlight from [[damotite]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] foresaw that her [[Planet/Legends|planet]] would soon switch to trenomite because of economic reasons.
